translations.web: The taskmasters were urgent saying, “Fulfill your work quota daily, as when there was straw!”
translations.bsb: The taskmasters kept pressing them, saying, “Fulfill your quota each day, just as you did when straw was provided.”
translations.kjv: And the taskmasters hasted them, saying, Fulfil your works, your daily tasks, as when there was straw.
translations.asv: And the taskmasters were urgent saying, Fulfil your works, your daily tasks, as when there was straw.
